info.name: CasePilot AI — Stage 3 Internal Lifecycle
info.description: Maintainer-only verification of Supabase lifecycle RPCs and normalized citations. This collection is not a browser or frontend API contract.

exec: const row = pm.response.json()[0]; pm.expect(row.status).to.eql('queued'); pm.environment.set('analysis_run_uuid', row.id);

item.name: Complete fixture run with cited summary and field

exec: if (!pm.environment.get('passage_uuid')) { throw new Error('Set passage_uuid from GET /v1/documents/{documentId} before completing this fixture run.'); }

pm.test('summary citation belongs to this run', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const row = pm.response.json()[0]; pm.expect(row.analysis_run_id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('analysis_run_uuid')); pm.expect(row.target_type).to.eql('case_summary'); pm.expect(row.passage_id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('passage_uuid')); });
